scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship to OBC Students (Maharashtra)
description: Financial assistance for Other Backward Class (OBC) students studying in post-matriculation courses in recognized institutions in Maharashtra.
benefits: Maintenance allowance ranging from ₹400 to ₹1200 per month and full/partial tuition fee reimbursement.
application_process: Apply online through the Maharashtra Direct Benefit Transfer (MahaDBT) portal.

description: Central sector scheme providing income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year payable in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each directly to bank accounts.
application_process: Register via the PM-KISAN portal or through local Common Service Centers (CSCs) and state agriculture department.

scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
description: Health insurance scheme by Government of Maharashtra providing cashless medical treatment for identified diseases to eligible families.
benefits: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹1.5 Lakhs per family per year (enhanced to ₹5 Lakhs for eligible categories).
application_process: Enroll at network hospitals with valid ration card and Aadhaar card; no prior registration required.

description: Financial assistance scheme by Government of Maharashtra for women aged 21 to 65 years to promote financial independence.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred directly to beneficiary bank accounts.
application_process: Apply through Nari Shakti Doot app or online portal designated by Women and Child Development Department, Maharashtra.

description: Central housing scheme to provide affordable housing to urban poor including Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) and Lower Income Groups (LIG).
benefits: Central assistance up to ₹1.5 Lakhs or interest subsidy on housing loans for construction/purchase of a house.
required_documents: Affidavit stating no pucca house owned
application_process: Apply online via PMAY-U official portal or through Common Service Centers (CSCs).

scheme_name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Scholarship Scheme
description: Educational fee reimbursement scheme for economically weaker students in professional and higher education in Maharashtra.
benefits: 50% tuition fee concession and 50% exam fee reimbursement for professional courses.
application_process: Apply via MahaDBT portal during the academic admission window.

description: Central scheme to promote apprenticeship training and incentivize employers to engage apprentices across industries.
benefits: Stipend support of up to ₹1,500 per month per apprentice shared with employers.
application_process: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training (NAPS) portal.

scheme_name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Vima Yojana
description: Accidental insurance scheme for farmers and farm workers in Maharashtra providing compensation in case of accidental death or permanent disability.
benefits: Compensation of up to ₹2,00,000 in case of accidental death or permanent disablement.
required_documents: 7/12 Land Extract or Certificate from Tahsildar
application_process: Application submitted through District Agriculture Officer within 90 days of accident.

description: World's largest health insurance scheme fully financed by government, providing coverage of ₹5 Lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
benefits: Cashless and paperless hospitalization benefit up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled hospitals.
application_process: Check eligibility online at PM-JAY portal or visit Ayushman Arogya Mandir / Common Service Center.

scheme_name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship for Secondary School Girls (Maharashtra)
description: Scholarship scheme by Maharashtra Government to encourage girls from backward classes to complete secondary education.
benefits: Annual financial incentive of ₹1,000 (₹100 per month for 10 months) for girls in 8th to 10th standard.
application_process: Applied through school headmaster on the Maharashtra Social Justice portal.

description: Financial scheme providing loans up to ₹10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10,00,000 under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
application_process: Apply directly through any participating commercial bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or online via Udyamimitra portal.

scheme_name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vastigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojana
description: Hostel maintenance allowance scheme for children of registered construction workers and economically weaker farmers in Maharashtra.
benefits: Maintenance allowance between ₹30,000 to ₹60,000 per year for students studying away from home in professional/higher education.
